problems.statement_en: We are given n ≥ 3 points in the plane. Let d be the maximal distance between two of the given points. Prove that the number of pairs of points whose distance is equal to d is less than or equal to n. (Poland) 1 The IMO Compendium Group, D. Djuki ́ c, V . Jankovi ́ c, I. Mati ́ c, N. Petrovi ́ c www.imomath.com
